## Context / Problem

`rebar store fsck` reports 1 counted `ORPHAN_EVENT` on ticket 77b6-868f-f4bd-461f: `1793763291917454423-f07d2f27-191e-4bd7-9091-1b10efb7ed38-TAG_DELTA.json` predates SNAPSHOT `4febf54c` and is not in its `source_event_uuids`, so the tag change is skipped on replay. The code cause is fixed under bug stormproof-stormy-toad; this task is the separate operator data repair of the existing row.

## Approach

An operator runs `rebar store fsck --repair-snapshots --dry-run`, checks the 77b6 plan rebuilds from CREATE, LINK and the TAG_DELTA, then runs `rebar store fsck --repair-snapshots` once on one clone so the rebuilt SNAPSHOT pushes to `origin/tickets`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `rebar store fsck --output json` reports 0 `orphan_event` rows for 77b6-868f-f4bd-461f on the operator clone and on the production MCP clone.
  provenance: environment=operator clone (/Users/joeoakhart/rebar/.tickets-tracker) and production MCP clone (/var/gerrit/site/mcp-tickets in rebar-mcp-7c3cb5e9a4f9-8093 on i-00880b2c7f13527c5); principal=Rebar Bot Nava via worktree .venv/bin/rebar at e0bfa4e5154, and SSM AWS-RunShellScript docker exec under the instance role; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — 2026-11-04: rebar store fsck --repair-snapshots on the operator clone rebuilt only the 77b6 SNAPSHOT and reported no issues after; local tickets == origin/tickets (dfefce8cada); the MCP clone log contains REBUILD SNAPSHOT 77b6-868f-f4bd-461f, and rebar store fsck --output json there reports 0 orphan_event rows (counted issues: 1 env_id_mismatch, tracked as placid-dreary-zethuswasp).
